stories.title: Essar Oil ordered to pay £873,473 over Stanlow refinery wastewater breaches
stories.summary: The operator of Stanlow oil refinery has been fined nearly £900,000 after breaking pollution limits on its wastewater at least 489 times in three years. stories.title: One in four Wrexham Maelor AE patients spent 12 hours or more there in October
stories.summary: Just over a third of patients at Wrexham Maelor Hospital’s emergency department were seen within four hours in October, new Welsh Government figures show. stories.summary: LINK, which runs the UK’s cash machine network, will carry out a new assessment of Holywell’s banking needs after the town lost its last bank. stories.title: Flintshire railway stations have busiest year on record, ORR figures show
stories.summary: Flintshire’s railway stations were used more than ever last year, with almost 943,000 entries and exits across the county’s nine stations. Figures from the Office of Rail and Road (ORR), published today (Thursday, 19 November), show use rose at every station in Flintshire between April 2025 and March 2026.
